{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 values) indicating market pessimism.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if true outcome exceeds forecast by >5% after a spike, adjust next period’s forecast upward to avoid underestimating momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast consistently overestimates true outcome (e.g., >10% over 3+ consecutive periods), reduce forecast by 10-15% to align with historical mean.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is neutral (0.00) — avoid overreacting to minor price fluctuations.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3-5 days after a spike, adjust forecast to reflect delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.50 or higher positive sentiment, increase forecast by 2-5% to account for bullish momentum.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early periods — if forecast is >10% above true outcome for 2+ consecutive days, reduce forecast by 5-10% to prevent overshoot."
  ]
}
